Youth Basketball

The YMCA Youth Basketball program provides a positive, supportive environment where kids can develop basketball skills, build confidence, and create lasting friendships. Whether your child is stepping onto the court for the first time or has years of experience, players of all skill levels and abilities are welcome.

The Youth Basketball season is held during the winter months.
Youth Basketball camp is during the summer.
All practices and games are held at Bluestone High School in Skipwith, VA.

Volunteer Coaches Needed! Our youth basketball program depends on volunteer coaches who help make each season a positive experience. The YMCA provides support and resources for every coach. Fill out a volunteer application here.

Age group eligibility is determined by age as of September 30th, 2026. This is so kids will play with others in the same grade level as themselves.

Playing UP in age level is an option but you will need to first register in the appropriate age group and then speak to the program director, Jenna Boswell. Her email is [email protected].

6U - Ages 5 & 6

All Locations
1/4/27 - 2/27/27
VIEW

Learn the Game. Build Confidence. Have Fun!

This league focuses on learning through fun activities, skill-building drills, and age-appropriate games that help every child feel successful, included, and excited to play.

Players Will Learn:

  • Basketball fundamentals and basic rules
  • Ball handling and coordination skills
  • Teamwork and sportsmanship
  • Confidence on and off the court

Program Information

  • One 60 minute practice each week
  • Games on Saturdays
  • All equipment is age-appropriate
  • No experience necessary
  • Schedules determined when registration closes
